Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Op­tiWare launch: proposed play-chart, milestones & owner commitments

Hi Emily —

Great meeting yesterday. As promised, attaching a first-pass "play-chart" that lays out the mutual action plan (MAP) for the staging -> prod launch. High-level goals: get a production-quality inference pipeline on Redwood Dedicated by the end of Q4, complete security signoffs, and validate latency/cost targets on a 10k-user pilot.

What you’ll find in the PDF: a milestone timeline (milestone dates and owners), a short RACI for critical tasks (networking, model pinning, SSO, data retention), and the kickoff agenda for next Tuesday. I flagged two items where we need OptiWare input to lock dates: 1) cert expiry/rotation window for your KMS, 2) selection of the first-ground-truth prompt set for quality gating.

Proposed next steps:
- Kickoff on Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:00 PT (video) — confirm attendee list
- OptiWare to confirm KMS rotation window by Mon Aug 24
- Redwood to share final SSO checklist and staging runbook by EOD Aug 25

Attachments: OptiWare_PlayChart_v1.pdf, OW-kickoff-agenda.xlsx

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@optiware.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@optiware.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Op­tiWare launch: proposed play-chart, milestones & owner commitments

Laura —

Thanks for the doc and the clear asks. Quick answers inline: we can do the kickoff on Tue 25 at 10am PT — Samir (Head of Infrastructure) will join and wants the network + KMS section up front.

KMS rotation window: our security team wants a 2-week maintenance window in early Oct (Oct 4–17) where we can rotate keys. Is that compatible with Redwood's timeline for the cert pinning? If not, we can discuss fallback options in the kickoff.

Prompt set: we’ll nominate a 25-prompt pilot set by EOD Wed Aug 26. Who should we upload it to?

Also, two small asks before the call: can Redwood share the expected list of IP/CIDR ranges we need to open to Dedicated pools, and a short description of the rollback policy in case the model variant swap causes regressions? I attached Samir’s calendar block for the kickoff.

—Emily
Emily Turner
VP, Product Operations
OptiWare, Inc.
emily.turner@optiware.com | +1 617-555-0123

[Inline: Samir Patel (adds availability)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Op­tiWare launch: proposed play-chart, milestones & owner commitments

Laura / team —

Reviewed OptiWare's replies. Quick internal notes to prepare before the kickoff: 

- Networking/CIDR: I’ll draft the minimal whitelist (4 ranges) and include both ephemeral and static egress options. Draft to Emily by EOD Tue.
- KMS/cert pinning: Marissa, can you confirm whether a mid-Oct rotation (Oct 4–17) will break our automated pinning flow? If so, propose a variant plan (staged rotation + rollback test).
- Prompt upload: Aditya, can you create an upload container (private S3 link) and a naming template so OptiWare can drop the CSV by Wed? Also add a checksum step.
- Rollback policy: I’ve pulled the short rollback blurb from our runbook (two-step: model swap + immediate scoped telemetry checks; fallback within 10m if regression + human approval). I'll paste the short summary into the kickoff notes.

I’ll attach the CIDR draft and the short rollback blurb to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cplaychart

Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Op­tiWare launch: proposed play-chart, milestones & owner commitments

Hi Emily / Samir —

Thanks for confirming the kickoff. Quick agenda update and the actions we walked through so everyone is clear going into the call: 

1) Logistics (5m) — introductions, success criteria recap
2) Network & KMS (15m) — Monica to present CIDR whitelist; Marissa to review cert pinning and rotation compatibility with the Oct 4–17 window
3) Pilot content & metrics (15m) — Aditya to show upload container and explain checksum/naming; OptiWare to confirm 25 prompts
4) Rollout plan & rollback (10m) — Laura to explain go/no-go gating and telemetry thresholds
5) Acceptance criteria and next milestones (10m) — agree on dates for staging test (target Sep 15) and production cutover target (target Nov 30)

Action items before the call (owners & due dates):
- OptiWare: confirm KMS rotation window is final (Emily) — due Mon Aug 24 (noted complete)
- OptiWare: upload 25-prompt CSV to provided container (Emily/Samir) — due Wed Aug 26
- Redwood: share final SSO checklist and staging runbook (Laura) — due Wed Aug 25 EOB (link below)
- Redwood: finalize CIDR whitelist (Monica) — due Tue Aug 25 5pm PT
- Redwood: document fallback model variants and rollback steps (Marissa) — due Tue Aug 25 5pm PT

I’ve uploaded the runbook link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cplaychart

See you Tuesday at 10:00 PT (video link in calendar invite). If anything else pops up, flag here and we’ll triage.

Best,
Laura Bennett
